description: This Java class provides utility methods for encrypting and decrypting data using symmetric encryption (AES) with PBKDF2 key derivation, including generating random salts and IVs, and encoding/decoding to Base64.

classes.name: EncryptionUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for encryption and decryption using AES with PBKDF2 key derivation.

methods.name: encryptToBase64
methods.description: Encrypts data with specified cipher type and master password, returning a Base64-encoded string containing IV, salt, and ciphertext.

methods.name: decryptFromBase64
methods.description: Decrypts Base64-encoded encrypted data using specified cipher type and master password, returning the original plaintext.

methods.name: generateKeySpec
methods.description: Generates a SecretKeySpec for AES encryption using PBKDF2 with the provided master password and salt.
